Rune reasoning: Warwick — Jaws of the Beast bite: Q5 is1.2AD+1AP+10% target maxHP MAGIC. AP/MR modifiers exploit1AP; compare AD swap because1.2AD also strong. Bloodline replaces non-scoring haste: 85 HP feeds the equipped Riftmaker HP-to-AP conversion. Keep conditional native modifiers separate from rune proc damage. Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly 15 earned stacks grant 85 HP, which equipped Riftmaker converts into AP; native output gains only through its actual HP/AP coefficients, not life-steal healing. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion. Bloodline benchmark: exactly 15 legitimately earned Legend stacks before measurement, granting 85 max HP. Read actual HP/AP after equipped conversions; with fewer stacks credit no completion HP. No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.

Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing [(1.2) × AD + (1) × AP] plus [6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10]% max Health magic damage and healing for [25 / 37.5 / 50 / 62.5 / 75]% of the damage dealt.

builds.name: Eternal Hunger: below-25% self-heal
builds.summary: Explore high one empowered Eternal Hunger self-heal output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high one empowered Eternal Hunger self-heal output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Passive on-hit magic damage is a level-scaled 6 to 55 + 0.15 bonus AD + 0.10 AP. Below 50% owner HP it heals for 100% of damage dealt; below 25% it heals for 250%. Target MR and penetration can therefore change the heal, unlike a purely AP-based heal formula.
